blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
blocks.zh: 为自递性语言模型收集大规模、多样和高质量的培训后数据集是一项挑战。 因此,监督的精细图解(SFT)通常被应用于比预训用得小得多的数据集,这导致数据分布尾巴的过度调整和灾难性地被遗忘. 为了防止这种倒闭,我们引入了Ambient SFT,这是一个利用不完善预测来增强微调集的原则框架. 在我们的方法中,"被冻结"的"被预先训练的"模型"版本充当了吵闹的老师,而精细的模型必须在粗糙的层面上相匹配. 特别是,我们要求训练后模式制作的有条件分发的高温版本应当与训练前的高温版本相匹配. 温度超参数计控制了对被预先训练的模型的信任程度,限制为$T\to\fty$返回到常规的SFT,而$T=1$返回到知识分馏. 我们证明,我们的做法超越了标准SFT,跨越域的适应、指示调整和推理,导致与标准SFT相比,平均高出21美元。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) has evolved into a complex, multi-stage pipeline ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2023 ; Abdin et al., 2024 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Olmo et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . This process typically progresses from massive-scale pre-training to more specialized post-training phases, including instruction-tuning ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , alignment ( Ziegler et al., 2019 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , and reasoning ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Lightman et al., 2023 ) . As models advance through this pipeline, data availability decreases by orders of magnitude. While pre-training corpora often encompass trillions of tokens, later stages frequently rely on datasets comprising merely a few thousand highly curated examples ( Zhou et al., 2023a ; Guha et al., 2025 ) . This severe bottleneck arises because post-training requires extraordinarily high-quality data, making large-scale collection prohibitively challenging ( Zhou et al., 2023a ) .
blocks.zh: 先进的大语言模型(LLMs)的发展演变为复杂,多阶段的管道(Liu等人,2024;Bai等人,2023;Abdin等人,2024;Achiam等人,2023;Olmo等人,2025;Grattafiori等人,2024). 这一过程通常从大规模培训前阶段发展到更专业的培训后阶段,包括教学调整(欧阳等人,2022年),调整 (Ziegler等人,2019年;Ouyang等人,2022年),和推理(Guo等人,2025年;Lightman等人,2023年). 随着模型通过这一管道的推进,数据提供量会减少。 虽然培训前公司通常包含数万亿令牌,但后期往往依赖只包含几千个高度整理的例子的数据集(周等人,2023a;古哈等人,2025年)。 造成这一严重瓶颈的原因是,培训后需要特别高质量的数据,使大规模收集工作极具挑战性(周等人,2023a)。

blocks.en: The stark contrast in data scale introduces undesirable artifacts. Most notably, post-trained LLMs tend to suffer from catastrophic forgetting at the tails of the pre-training data distribution, overfitting instead to the specific stylistic patterns or narrow viewpoints overrepresented in the limited post-training data ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . This phenomenon is known as the alignment tax ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . The prevailing solution to this bottleneck is brute force: allocating vast financial and computational resources to scale up the collection of post-training data. In this work, we ask a different question: are there algorithmic solutions that can increase the data efficiency of post-training without inducing severe model collapse or overfitting?
blocks.zh: 数据尺度的鲜明对比引入了不受欢迎的文物. 最明显的是,经过培训的LLMs往往在培训前数据分发的尾声中遭受灾难性的遗忘,而与具体的形式模式过于一致,或者在有限的培训后数据中代表过多的狭隘观点(Oyang等人,2022年;Lin等人,2024年)。 这种现象被称为对齐税(欧阳等人,2022年). 解决这一瓶颈的主要办法是野蛮的力量:分配大量财政和计算资源,以扩大培训后数据的收集。 在这部作品中,我们提出了另一个问题:是否有算法解决方案可以提高训练后的数据效率,同时又不会诱发严重的模型崩溃或过度适应?

blocks.en: We start our approach to this problem by performing a thought experiment. Imagine having access to an oracle LLM that can generate the high-quality post-training data distribution, but you can only observe a high-temperature, noisy version of its predictions. We show that learning from high-temperature data can match the performance of training on the true, standard-temperature distribution, provided the sample size is large enough. For a practical algorithm, we do not have a perfect high-temperature oracle, but we can effectively approximate it using a high-temperature weak model, which is the model prior to post-training. Distributionally, any two models converge as the sampling temperature increases; thus, at a sufficiently high temperature, a readily available weak model serves as a strong proxy for the unavailable oracle. This motivates our proposed approach: during post-training, we augment our dataset using a weak teacher operating at a high temperature. We enforce that the post-trained model matches the weak teacher’s distribution at this high temperature, while remaining unconstrained to refine its conditional distributions at the standard temperature ( T = 1 T=1 ). The temperature hyperparameter explicitly controls the level of trust placed in the pre-trained model, with the T → ∞ T\to\infty limit gracefully reverting to standard SFT and with T = 1 T=1 to knowledge distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过进行思想实验来着手解决这个问题。 想象一下,可以访问一个能生成高质量训练后数据分布的甲骨文LLM,但只能观察其预测的高温,噪音版本. 我们显示,从高温数据中学习,只要样本体积足够大,就可以匹配关于真实,标准温度分布的培训性能. 对于实用算法来说,我们没有完美的高温甲骨文,但是我们可以使用高温弱模型有效地进行近似,这是后训练前的模型. 在分布上,随着采样温度的升高,任何两种模型都趋同;因此,在足够高的温度下,一个容易获得的弱模型是无法使用的甲骨文的有力代名词。 这激励了我们提议的办法:在培训后,我们利用一个在高温下运作的弱小教师来增加我们的数据集。 我们强制要求训练后模式在这种高温下与弱师资分布相匹配,同时保持不受限制,在标准温度下完善其有条件分布(T=1T=1). 温度超参数仪明确控制预先训练的模型中的信任程度,T → → T\to\\ fty 优雅地限制返回标准SFT, T = 1 T = 1 到知识蒸馏.

blocks.en: Our algorithm, termed Ambient SFT, mitigates the overfitting typically observed when applying Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to small datasets. It achieves this by adding to the standard SFT loss a second term, which we call Temperature Matching, that regularizes the post-trained network to match the high-temperature conditional distributions of its pre-trained predecessor. We evaluate Ambient SFT across three standard post-training paradigms: (i) domain adaptation, (ii) instruction-tuning, and (iii) the development of reasoning capabilities. Across all settings, our approach consistently outperforms standard SFT. In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的算法称为Ambient SFT,减轻了在对小数据集应用监督精选(SFT)时通常观察到的过度配制。 它通过在标准SFT损失中增加第二个术语来达到这个目的,我们称之为温匹配,这个术语将经过训练后的网络正规化,以匹配其经过训练的前身的高温有条件分布. 我们评价了Ambient SFT在培训后的三个标准范式:(一) 领域适应,(二) 指导调整,(三) 推理能力的发展。 在所有情况下,我们的方法一贯优于标准SFT。 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce Ambient SFT , a drop-in replacement for standard SFT that regularizes fine-tuning by matching a high-temperature version of the model’s own pre-trained distribution. A single temperature knob interpolates between SFT and knowledge distillation. • We prove that a target distribution can be recovered from high-temperature conditionals alone, that any two models’ conditionals contract as the temperature grows, and that under a log-linear model Ambient SFT strictly beats vanilla SFT and knowledge distillation. • We show gains in all three post-training regimes: up to 26.7 % 26.7\% lower perplexity than the best baseline across five domain-adaptation targets; average relative gains of 8.0 % 8.0\% to 20.3 % 20.3\% on instruction tuning and wins on 5 / 6 5/6 reasoning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了 Ambient SFT,作为标准 SFT的即时替代, 它通过匹配高温版本的模型本身的预训发行来规范微调. 在SFT和知识蒸馏之间插入一个单一的温度节点。 我们证明目标分布可以单从高温条件中回收,任何两种模型的有条件合同随着温度的增长,在对数线模型Ambient SFT下严格地比起香草SFT和知识蒸馏. ^ 我们在所有三个培训后体制中都取得了进步:在5个域调整目标中,比最佳基线低26.7%、26.7%、平均相对收益8.0%、8.0%、20.3%、在5/6、5/6、6个推理基准上获胜。

The need for post-training. In practice, we do not have oracle access to the true distribution p p . However, collecting a sufficiently large dataset directly from p p is often prohibitively expensive. For example, p p might represent the distribution of expert-level textbooks or highly specialized instruction-following dialogues. While such in-distribution data is scarce, there exists an abundance of generic text on the web, drawn from a broader, different distribution q q . blocks.zh: 3 方法和理论结果

blocks.en: Problem setting. In our setting, we assume access to a pre-trained model θ pre ∗ \theta^{*}_{\mathrm{pre}} but not necessarily to the pre-training dataset 𝒟 q \mathcal{D}_{q} . Our goal is to adapt this model to capture as best as possible the distribution p p , from which we only have access to a small dataset 𝒟 p = { 𝐱 ( k ) } k = 1 n 1 \mathcal{D}_{p}=\{\mathbf{x}^{(k)}\}_{k=1}^{n_{1}} .
3.1 Ambient SFT algorithm
blocks.zh: 3.1 环境SFT算法

We start by presenting our algorithm right away.

We refer to the full objective of Eq. ( 4 ) as Ambient SFT and to its second term as Temperature Matching. The name connects to Ambient Diffusion ( Daras et al., 2023 ; Daras et al., 2024 ; Daras et al., 2025 ; Rodríguez-Muñoz et al., 2026 ) , a line of work that trains diffusion models from corrupted data. Computational overhead. Since Ambient SFT requires an additional forward pass through the frozen teacher, it is more expensive than the regular SFT. Using the standard approximation that a backward pass costs roughly twice a forward pass, the expected per-step compute relative to plain fine-tuning is 1 + 1 − p c 3 ⋅ C teacher C student 1+\frac{1-p_{c}}{3}\cdot\frac{C_{\text{teacher}}}{C_{\text{student}}} ,
where C teacher / C student C_{\text{teacher}}/C_{\text{student}} is the ratio of teacher to student forward-pass cost. For our Experiments, we typically set p c = 0.75 p_{c}=0.75 and we use the same model for the student and the teacher. This makes training ≈ 1.1 × \approx 1.1\times slower for the same amount of steps. Hence, Ambient SFT is best suited to settings that are data-limited rather than compute-limited .

blocks.en:
Clarification and Related Work. Sometimes in the literature the term KD is used to refer to matching any teacher distribution, independent of the smoothing temperature T T . In fact, Hinton et al. (2015) experiment with matching at different temperatures. The main difference is that we use the pre-trained model to supervise itself during post-training. An algorithm relevant to ours is the one from Li & Hoiem (2017) . There a model is adapted to a new task while
avoiding catastrophic forgetting of old tasks through regularization toward its own temperature-softened predictions on the previous tasks using new task’s inputs. In LwF the new task has its own output head, so the distillation and new-task losses interact only through shared features. In our work, the output space is shared. This changes the role of temperature that is set to a fixed choice in LwF. In Ambient SFT, the temperature controls a bias-variance trade-off (Theorem 3.2 ), and it is set based on how much the student trusts the base model. More discussion about related work is presented in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
澄清及相关工作。 有时在文献中,KD一词用来指匹配任何师资分布,独立于平滑温度T T T. 事实上,Hinton等人(2015年)在不同的温度下进行了匹配实验. 主要的区别在于我们使用经过预训的模型在训练后进行自我监督. 与我们相关的算法是李和合(2017年)的算法. 这里有一个模型适应一个新的任务,同时
避免灾难性地忘记旧任务,办法是通过调整方式,利用新任务的投入,对以前的任务进行温和预测。 在LwF中,新任务有自己的输出头,因此蒸馏和新任务损失只能通过共享的特性相互作用. 在我们的工作中,输出空间是共享的. 这改变了温度在LwF中被设定为固定选择的作用. 在Ambient SFT(英语:Ambient SFT)中,温度控制着偏差-变量的权衡(定理3.2),它是根据学生对基准模型的信任程度设定的. 关于相关工作的更多讨论见第5节。

blocks.en: 3.2 Theoretical Analysis of the Algorithm
blocks.zh: 3.2 算法理论分析

blocks.en: We now analyze Ambient SFT theoretically: we show that pure temperature matching is equivalent to learning from high-temperature samples, characterize how fast temperature contracts distributional differences, and establish the statistical benefits of Ambient SFT under a simple log-linear model. Readers interested mainly in the empirical results can skip to Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们现在从理论上分析 Ambient SFT : 我们显示纯温度匹配 相当于从高温样本中学习, 描述温度如何快速与分布差异, 在简单的对数线模型下确定 Ambient SFT 的统计效益。 对经验结果感兴趣的读者可以跳到第四节。

blocks.en: We are now ready to put all the pieces together. Theorem 3.1 establishes the equivalence of Temperature Matching to learning from corrupted data from the teacher and shows that for any finite T T , the teacher distribution is the minimizer of this term alone. Training with Temperature Matching alone would be problematic since we would not be able to move from the pre-training distribution. Our algorithm trains with both regular SFT and Temperature Matching, with a choice of temperature T T controlling the level at which the gradients from the weak teacher can be reliable, as quantified by Eq. ( 6 ). The questions left to answer are: (a) what is the right choice of temperature in the temperature matching term, and (b) for the optimal amount of temperature, do we get any statistical advantage compared to learning from regular SFT alone? In what follows, we answer those questions. To avoid arguing about how LLMs generalize to new contexts not seen in training, we adopt a simple log-linear next-token model with frozen features, and analyze ( 4 ) on it exactly.

blocks.en: 4.1 Learning from high-temperature data
blocks.zh: 4.1 学习高温数据

blocks.en: We first verify that training on high-temperature samples can still recover the original ( T = 1 T=1 ) distribution. We train a model on a dataset 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , sample from it at temperature T T to obtain 𝒟 T ′ \mathcal{D}_{T}^{\prime} , train a new model on 𝒟 T ′ \mathcal{D}_{T}^{\prime} with Eq. ( 12 ), and measure its perplexity on a clean validation set.

blocks.en:
For our first toy experiment, we use a GPT-2 architecture, and we train it on the tiny Shakespeare dataset ( Karpathy, 2015 ) . Figure 2(b) shows the validation perplexity of a model trained with the objective of Eq. ( 12 ) and a baseline trained with the normal loss function of Eq. ( 2 ) for different temperatures. As shown, our algorithm achieves relatively low validation perplexity with respect to the clean distribution even for high training corruption strengths. We proceed to repeat the idea at a larger scale. We train a GPT-2 124M model on OpenWebText ( ≈ 9 \approx 9 B tokens), and we use it to produce synthetic data at different temperatures as before. Figure 2(a) shows examples of training and generated data. The model is capable of producing clean samples even though it has only been trained with text that appears gibberish.
These experiments validate that the high-temperature distributions still have usable learning signal, despite the seemingly uninformative training data.
Theorem 3.1 establishes that Temperature Matching is exactly equivalent to learning from corrupted samples.

这些实验证实,高温分布仍然有可用的学习信号,尽管似乎没有信息化的培训数据.

blocks.en: 4.2 Domain Adaptation Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 域适应实验

blocks.en:
We proceed to post-training experiments, beginning with domain adaptation : a model pre-trained on generic text needs to be adapted to a new domain from which we don’t have much data.
We start with an 1.5 1.5 B-parameter model pre-trained on OpenWebText. We adapt to five target domains, chosen to span diverse text types: Python code ( CodeParrot Team, 2022 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) ), CS papers ( Lo et al., 2020 ) , biomedical text ( Stuhlmann et al., 2025 ) , news ( Hamborg et al., 2017 ) , and product reviews ( Hou et al., 2026 ) , each using ≈ \approx 225M tokens. We benchmark: (a) training from scratch on the domain of interest, (b) fine-tuning, (c) data-mixing (where we split training updates between the pre-training domain and the target domain), (d) our Ambient SFT approach. We always pick the hyperparameters that achieve the lowest validation perplexity in the target domain. Our algorithm has two hyperparameters p c p_{c} , which controls how often we apply the Temperature Matching loss and the temperature T T . We give a full sweep of these parameters in Appendix C.1.2 .

Predicting the success of Ambient SFT. The benefit varies across domains: it is largest on Python Code and News and smaller elsewhere. Because success depends on how much the teacher knows about the target domain, a cheap and reliable predictor of the benefit is the model’s perplexity on the target domain before fine-tuning.
Across the five domains, this heuristic gives a Spearman rank correlation of ρ = − 0.90 \rho=-0.90 between zero-shot loss and win margin to the baselines. This is qualitatively consistent with Theorem 3.2 , whose bias term depends on the discrepancy B = A θ post ∗ − A θ pre ∗ B=A_{\theta^{*}_{\mathrm{post}}}-A_{\theta^{*}_{\mathrm{pre}}} . blocks.en: Effect of the size of the student and teacher. In our experiments so far, the teacher is the frozen model after pre-training and the student is initialized from this teacher. Table 21 isolates the effect of student and teacher capacity, testing four combinations of student size (124M, 1.5B) and teacher size (124M, 1.5B). Two trends are unsurprising: (a) a larger student improves results at both teacher sizes, and (b) a larger teacher improves results at both student sizes. A third, less obvious finding is that a small (124M) teacher can still improve a strictly larger (1.5B) student, a pairing that classical KD would not predict to help. Pairing the 1.5B student with the 124M teacher beats plain fine-tuning of the same 1.5B student with no teacher at all on Python Code and News.

blocks.en: Effect of number of tokens of the target domain. To understand the effect of the size of the fine-tuning dataset, we subsample the Python Code training set, keeping only 1 / 3 1/3 and 1 / 10 1/10 , and finetune a 124M model on each subsampled set with both Ambient SFT and the Data Mixture baseline. Figure 3(b) reports the results: our method consistently outperforms the baseline, and the gap widens as the dataset shrinks. This is intuitive: with enough target-domain data, our method should not help, but it is highly effective when data, not compute, is the bottleneck. This matches Theorem 3.2 : the bias term is independent of n n , while the sampling-variance term is not.
blocks.zh: 目标域符号数的效果 。 为了了解微调数据集的大小影响,我们对Python代码培训集进行子样本,只保留1/3 1/3和1/10 1/10,并在每个子样本集上用Ambient SFT和Data Mixture基线对124M模型进行微调. 图3(b)报告了结果:我们的方法一贯超过基线,随着数据集缩小,差距扩大。 这是直观的:有足够的目标域数据,我们的方法不应该有所帮助,但是当数据而不是计算数据是瓶颈时,它非常有效. 这符合定理3.2:偏差词独立于n ,而采样-变量词则不是.

blocks.en: 4.3 Instruction-tuning experiments
blocks.zh: 4.3 指令调整试验

blocks.en:
Having established Ambient SFT as a drop-in replacement for SFT in domain adaptation, we now ask whether it helps elsewhere in the post-training stack, starting with instruction tuning, where a pre-trained LLM is trained via SFT to follow instructions. We start with pre-trained base models, ranging from 1.7 1.7 B to 14 14 B params, and we fine-tune them on the Dolci-Instruct-SFT ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) .
We start our evaluation by using only ≈ 20 \approx 20 K documents ( ≈ 18 \approx 18 M tokens).
We validate performance on standard benchmarks that measure instruction following (IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023b ) ), knowledge (MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2020 ) , PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) , TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) ), math (GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) ), code (HumanEval+ ( Chen et al., 2021 ) ), and general reasoning (BBH ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ) ). For all our runs, we use p c = 0.75 p_{c}=0.75 (i.e., 25 % 25\% of the updates are spent on the Temperature Matching term) and T = 2.5 T=2.5 .

将Ambient SFT设定为域内适应中SFT的即时替代,我们现在问它是否有助于训练后堆栈的其他地方,从指令调试开始,通过SFT训练预训的LLM以听从指令. 我们从训练前的基础模型开始,从1.7 B到14 B的14个参数不等,我们在Dolci-Instruct-SFT上对其进行微调(Olmo等人,2025年)。
我们只用 QQ 20 \ 大约 20 K 文件( QQ 18\ 大约 18 M 令牌) 开始评估 。
我们验证下列标准基准的绩效:衡量指令遵循(IFEval(周等人,2023b)),知识(MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2020年),PopQA(Mallen等人,2023年),TriviaQA(Joshi等人,2017年),数学(GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),MATH(Hendrycks等人,2021年)),代码(HumanEval+(Chen等人,2021年)),一般推理(BBH(Suzgun等人,2023年)). 在我们的所有运行中,我们使用p c = 0.75 p = = 0.75 p = 0.75 (即更新中25% = 25 = 用于温度匹配术语)和T = 2.5 T = 2.5.

blocks.en:
Results are presented in Table 2 , where we show results for Qwen3 models ranging from 1.7B to 14B parameters. We start by analyzing what Vanilla SFT does to the capabilities of the underlying model. As shown, Vanilla SFT improves instruction-following capabilities by a lot (e.g. IFEval increases from 45.5 % 45.5\% to 76.3 % 76.3\% at the 4B scale) but leads to catastrophic forgetting on the rest of the benchmarks: the base model (pre-SFT) beats vanilla-SFT on 6 or 7 tasks for every model. On the contrary,
Ambient SFT leads to consistent average improvements ranging from 8.0 % 8.0\% to 20.3 % 20.3\% . At every size and model family, Ambient SFT matches or beats vanilla SFT on every benchmark except IFEval, and significantly outperforms the base model on IFEval.
Beyond that, Ambient SFT mostly preserves knowledge (MMLU, PopQA, TriviaQA), and increases capabilities in math : it is above the base model on both GSM8K and MATH for almost every model tested.

表2列出了结果,其中显示的Quen3模型结果从1.7B到14B参数不等。 我们首先分析Vanilla SFT对基本模型能力的影响。 如所示,Vanilla SFT通过很多方式改进了跟随指令的能力(例如,在4B尺度上,IFEval从45.5% +%增加到76.3% +% 76.3 +%),但会导致其他基准的灾难性遗忘:基础模型(SFT前)在每个模型的6或7个任务上击败了Vanilla-SFT. 相反,
环境SFT导致从8.0% 8.0%到20.3% 20.3%的连续平均改善。 在每一个大小和模型家族中,Ambient SFT在除IFEval以外的每个基准上匹配或击败了香草SFT,并显著超越了IFEval上的基础模型.
除此之外,Ambient SFT大多保存了知识(MMLU,PopQA,TriviaQA),并提高了数学能力:几乎每个测试的模型都高于GSM8K和MATH的基础模型.

Per-source temperature. The only benchmark where Ambient SFT is worse than vanilla SFT is IFEval. We find the problem originates from the composition of our dataset. Dolci-Instruct-SFT mixes 21 sources, and the base model fits some of them much better than others.
Setting the temperature separately for each source improves IFEval at every model size, while keeping other gains. Results are shown in Table 3 and details on how to set the temperature for each source are given in Appendix D.5 .

That said, even at full data scale , Ambient SFT leads to an average 8.6 % 8.6\% relative improvement to vanilla SFT. Figure 6 shows per-benchmark scores across different scales.

blocks.en: Ambient SFT reduces overfitting. We hypothesize that Ambient SFT reduces overfitting, letting the model benefit from more epochs than vanilla SFT. To test this, we train for 2 2 , 4 4 , 6 6 , 8 8 , and 10 10 epochs on a 10 % 10\% subset of Dolci-Instruct-SFT (215k examples). As Figure 4 shows, Ambient SFT reaches its best performance at more epochs and is more robust to overfitting.
blocks.zh: Ambient SFT减少过度配装. 我们假设Ambient SFT能减少过度适应, 让模型从比香草SFT更多的时代中获益. 为了测试这一点,我们为Dolci-Instruct-SFT(215k例)的10%的10个10世纪的2,2,4,4,6,6,8,和10个10个世纪进行训练. 如图4所示,Ambient SFT在更多时代达到最佳性能,并且更强壮到过度适应.

blocks.en: Vanilla SFT trades knowledge for instruction following. For vanilla SFT, the number of epochs controls a trade-off. Going from 2 2 to 6 6 epochs raises IFEval from 71.0 71.0 to 80.8 80.8 , but lowers every other benchmark: MATH from 37.3 37.3 to 30.0 30.0 , GSM8K from 76.4 76.4 to 69.6 69.6 , HumanEval+ from 81.3 81.3 to 75.5 75.5 , MMLU from 66.3 66.3 to 65.0 65.0 , PopQA from 19.4 19.4 to 17.2 17.2 , TriviaQA from 63.7 63.7 to 59.2 59.2 and BBH from 62.8 62.8 to 58.9 58.9 . Stopping early therefore limits forgetting only by giving up instruction following. Ambient SFT does not face this trade-off: over the same range, IFEval rises from 63.8 63.8 to 73.4 73.4 , while the other benchmarks stay within about two points of their 2-epoch values.
blocks.zh: Vanilla SFT 将知识用于以下教学。 对于香草SFT来说,时代的数量控制着一个权衡. 从2 2 到6 6 个历程将IFEval从71.0 71.0提高到80.8 80.8, 但降低其他基准: MATH从37.3 37.3到30.030.0,GSM8K从76.4 76.4到69.6 69.6,HumanEval+从81.3到75.5 75.5,MMLU从66.3 66.3到65.65.0,PopQA从19.4 19.4到17.2 17.2,TriviaQA从63.7 63.7到59.2 59.2,BBBH从62.8 62.8到58.9 58.9 (英语). 因此,停止早期限制只能通过放弃后续指令而忘记。 Ambient SFT并不面临这种权衡:在同一范围内,IFEval从63.8 63.8上升到73.4 73.4 73.4,而其他基准则停留在它们两个时代价值的大约两点之内.

To compare with other regularizers, Table 5 shows results on Qwen3-1.7B with L2-SP ( Li et al., 2018 ) , NEFTune ( Jain et al., 2024 ) , KD toward the frozen base model at T = 1 T=1 , and label smoothing, each at its best setting. Ambient SFT outperforms other regularization methods. It reaches + 20.3 % +20.3\% over vanilla SFT, with the second best method being KD (Ambient SFT with T = 1 T=1 ) with + 17.0 % +17.0\% .

blocks.en: 4.4 Reasoning experiments
blocks.zh: 4.4 理由实验

blocks.en: Finally, we test whether Ambient SFT benefits reasoning. We train OLMo-3-7B on ≈ 22 \approx 22 K examples ( 1 % 1\% ) of Dolci-Think-SFT ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) with the same hyperparameters as before. We evaluate on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , AIME 2024 and 2025, HumanEval+ ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023b ) , and GPQA ( Rein et al., 2023 ) (details in Appendix C.3.1 ). As Table 6 shows, Ambient SFT outperforms vanilla SFT on 5/6 benchmarks and trails by only 1.2 1.2 points on GSM8K. While there is a consistent boost in reasoning abilities, its magnitude is smaller compared to the one observed for domain adaptation and instruction-tuning. That said, Table 23 further shows that reasoning models trained with Ambient SFT are also more robust to prompting than pure SFT ones. Ambient SFT also is the only regularization method that leads to improvements over SFT for reasoning, as both KD and L2-SP lead to regression in the reasoning scores.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们检验安比恩SFT是否有利于推理. 我们训练OLMo - 3 - 7B 在#################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################### (Olmo等人,2025年),具有与前作相同的超参数. 我们对GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),AIME 2024年和2025年,HumanEval+(Chen等人,2021年),IFEval(Zhou等人,2023年b)以及GPQA(Rein等人,2023年)进行了评估(详见附录C.3.1)。 如表6所示,在GSM8K上,Ambient SFT在5/6基准和小径上仅比香草SFT差1.2分. 虽然推理能力不断提高,但与观测到的领域适应和教学调整相比,其规模较小。 尽管如此,表23进一步表明,经过安比特SFT培训的推理模型也比纯粹的SFT模型更能激励人心. Ambient SFT也是导致SFT的推理改进的唯一规范化方法,因为KD和L2SP都会导致推理分数的回归.

5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work builds upon the Knowledge Distillation (KD) literature pioneered by Buciluǎ et al. (2006) and Hinton et al. (2015) . In the context of LLMs, KD has been successfully applied in the works of ( Kim & Rush, 2016 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2019 ) . However, whereas classical KD employs a teacher that is stronger or more aligned than the student, our framework inverts this dynamic: the teacher model is strictly weaker at the target task. Because the student (the fine-tuned model) is expected to outperform the teacher (the frozen pre-trained model), the teacher’s role is not to act as an oracle. Instead, it serves to regularize the fine-tuning process by providing coarse, high-temperature supervision. We also note that applying KD on smoothed distributions has been explored in the paper by ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) and an explicit scaling term 1 / T 2 1/T^{2} has been proposed. In our experiments, we do not find this scaling to be optimal across all of our settings, and we apply Knowledge Distillation to a previous version of the same model instead of an external more powerful teacher. The concept of self-distillation has also been explored in ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . The main difference between this work and ours is that we match towards the full high-temperature distribution of the teacher, while the authors of ( Yang et al., 2024 ) run SFT over datasets produced by the model.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作以Buciluê等人(2006年)和Hinton等人(2015年)开创的知识消化(KD)文献为基础。 在LLMS方面,KD成功应用于(Kim & Rush, 2016;Gu等人, 2023;Zhang等人, 2019)的作品中. 然而,尽管古典 KD 雇用了一个比学生更强或更一致的教师,但我们的框架却颠倒了这种动态:在目标任务上,教师模式严格来说是弱的。 因为学生(微调模式)有望超越老师(冷冻的预训模式),所以老师的作用并不是充当神谕. 相反,它通过提供粗糙的高温监督,使微调过程正规化。 我们还注意到,文件(Hinton等人,2015年)探讨了将KD应用于平滑分布的问题,并提出了明确的缩放术语1/T 2 1/T^{2}。 在我们的实验中,我们并不认为这个缩放 是我们所有环境的最优化的, 我们把“知识消化”应用到同一个模型的前版本, 而不是一个更强大的外部老师。 自我消化的概念也在(Yang等人,2024年)中探索. 这部作品与我们的主要区别在于,我们与老师的完全高温分布相匹配,而作者(杨等人,2024年)则在模型制作的数据集上运行SFT.

blocks.en: Closer to our setting is the continual-learning literature on avoiding catastrophic forgetting without access to the original training data. Li & Hoiem (2017) propose recording the pre-update network’s outputs on the new task’s own inputs and adds a temperature-softened distillation term to the new task’s loss, anchoring the update to the model’s previous behavior without replaying old data. Our method shares that structure: the frozen pre-trained model is queried on the fine-tuning data itself, and the match is enforced after raising the temperature.
blocks.zh: 更接近于我们的背景是不断学习有关避免灾难性的遗忘而无法获得原始培训数据的文献。 Li & Hoiem (2017)提议将更新前的网络产出记录在新任务本身的投入上,并在新任务的损失中加入一个温柔的蒸馏术语,将更新锁定在模型之前的行为上而不重播旧数据. 我们的方法共享这个结构:在微调数据本身上询问被冻结的预训练模型,在提高温度后执行匹配.

blocks.en: The concept of anchoring a model to a prior state also frequently appears in reinforcement learning (RL) alignment pipelines, where a KL-divergence penalty against a reference model is used to prevent reward hacking ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . Our framework diverges from this paradigm in two critical ways. First, our method targets the Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) stage rather than the RL phase. Second, we exclusively match the high-temperature distributions of the reference model. Enforcing a strict match at T = 1 T=1 would actively degrade performance by forcing the student to adopt the unaligned base model’s lack of task awareness, a manifestation of the phenomenon known as alignment tax ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . By matching the reference model only at a coarse level, our method successfully avoids this tax while maintaining structural regularization. Table 7 in Appendix A summarizes how Ambient SFT differs from these techniques.
blocks.zh: 将模型固定在先前状态的概念也经常出现在强化学习(RL)的对齐管道中,其中KL对参照模型的对KL-潜水处罚用于防止奖励黑客(Oyang等人,2022年). 我们的框架在两个关键方面偏离了这一范式。 首先,我们的方法针对的是监督的Fine-Tuning(SFT)阶段而不是RL阶段. 第二,我们完全符合参照模型的高温分布。 在T=1 T=1中强制严格匹配会通过强迫学生采用不协调的基础模式缺乏任务意识来积极降低性能,这是被称为对齐税的现象的表现(欧阳等人,2022年). 通过仅在粗略水平上匹配参考模式,我们的方法在保持结构正规化的同时,成功地避免了这种税收. 附录中的表7 总结一下Ambient SFT与这些技术有何不同。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced Ambient SFT, a drop-in replacement for SFT that adds to the standard cross-entropy loss a term matching the model to a high-temperature version of its own pre-trained predictions. Across domain adaptation, instruction tuning, and reasoning, Ambient SFT outperforms vanilla SFT, with the largest gains when fine-tuning data are scarce. A natural next step is to extend this anchoring idea beyond SFT to the reinforcement-learning algorithms used in post-training.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Ambient SFT,作为SFT的倒置替代,在标准跨跨跨度损失中增加了一个术语,将模型匹配到自身预训预测的高温版本. 纵观域调适,指令调和推理,Ambient SFT优于香草SFT,在微调数据稀缺时收益最大. 一个自然的下一步是将这个锚定想法扩展到SFT以外的训练后使用的加固学习算法.

blocks.en: C.2 Instruction Tuning

blocks.en: C.2.1 Training hyperparameters
blocks.zh: C.2.1 训练超参数

blocks.en: Every instruction-tuning run in this paper uses the same training recipe, listed in Table 15 ; vanilla SFT and Ambient SFT differ only in the loss. Runs are trained with the OLMo-core trainer, starting from each model’s released base checkpoint. The recipe follows Ai2’s instruction-tuning recipe for OLMo 3 (learning rate, schedule, batch size and sequence length) and is kept fixed across base models and model sizes; we did not tune it per model. The one exception is Llama-3.1-8B (Table 4 ), for which both vanilla SFT and Ambient SFT use a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} . The only settings that change between experiments are the number of epochs (Table 16 ) and the tokenizer, which is each base model’s own. Every run uses 16 GH200 GPUs; the global batch is fixed in tokens, so the gradient-accumulation factor absorbs the context-parallel degree.

blocks.en: C.2.2 Evaluation harness
blocks.zh: C.2.2 评价手段

blocks.en: All instruction-tuning results (Tables 2 , 4 and Figure 4 ) come from a single, fixed evaluation setup, applied identically to every checkpoint. We use the olmes evaluation suite ( Gu et al., 2024 ) ( github.com/allenai/olmes , commit 5a51f502 , unmodified) with the vLLM backend (vLLM 0.13.0, PyTorch 2.9.0, Transformers 4.57.6, Python 3.11). Trained checkpoints are converted to the Hugging Face format and evaluated with the chat template stored alongside them: the OLMo 3 instruct template ( <|im_start|> / <|im_end|> turns with its default system prompt), which is also the template used to format the training data, for all three base models. Every checkpoint is evaluated once per task, with no selection over seeds or decoding settings.
blocks.zh: 所有指示调试结果(表2、表4和图4)均来自单一的固定评价结构,适用于每个检查站。 我们使用olmes评价套件(Gu等人,2024年)(github.com/allenai/olmes,承诺5a51f502,未修改)与vLLM后端(vLLM 0.13.0,PyTorch 2.9.0,变形器 4.57.6,Python 3.11). 训练有素的检查站被转换成Hugging Face格式,并用存放在旁边的聊天模板来评价:OLMo 3指示模板(<| im_start|> / im_end|>)与其默认系统快捷转弯,这也是用于格式化训练数据的模板,适用于所有三个基础模型. 每个检查站每个任务都经过一次评价,没有选择种子或解码设置。

blocks.en: Table 17 lists the eight task specifications. “Chat” tasks format each prompt (including the few-shot examples, as earlier turns) with the chat template; “plain” tasks feed a raw text prompt. The reported score is the task’s primary metric; for MMLU, MATH and BBH it is the unweighted mean over their subjects or subtasks. The relative change reported in the last column of the instruction-tuning tables is the mean over the eight tasks of ( score − score SFT ) / score SFT (\text{score}-\text{score}_{\text{SFT}})/\text{score}_{\text{SFT}} .
blocks.zh: 表17列出了八项任务规格。 “ 聊天” 任务格式为每个带有聊天模板的提示( 包括几个镜头的例子, 如先前的转弯) ; “ 平面” 任务输入一个原始文本提示 。 报告得分是任务的主要衡量标准;对于MMLU、MATH和BBH来说,是对其主体或子任务未加权的平均值。 指示调制表最后一栏中报告的相对变化是: 超过八项任务的平均值: (分数 - 分数 SFT) / 分数 SFT (\text{score} -\text{score}/\text{SFT}}}/\text{score{xext{SFT}}).

blocks.en: Table 17: Task specifications used for every instruction-tuning evaluation. All generation is greedy except HumanEval+, which draws 20 samples per problem to estimate pass@10. MATH uses the Minerva chain-of-thought prompt format ( Lewkowycz et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 表17:每次指导调整评价采用的任务规格。 除了HumanEval+之外,所有一代都是贪婪的,每个问题都抽取20个样本来估计通过@10. MATH采用Minerva链式思维快速格式(Lewkowycz等人,2022年).

blocks.en:
Commands. The environment and the evaluation of one checkpoint $CKPT (a Hugging Face model directory) are: git clone https://github.com/allenai/olmes.git && cd olmes
git checkout 5a51f502d463b8cdc4a2dcad7d7096c41ff1197e
pip install -e . && pip install vllm==0.13.0

export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
MARGS="gpu_memory_utilization=0.85,max_length=32768"
MARGS="$MARGS,trust_remote_code=false,add_bos_token=false"
TASKS="ifeval::tulu mmlu::olmes gsm8k::olmes codex_humanevalplus::tulu"
TASKS="$TASKS minerva_math::tulu popqa::tulu"
TASKS="$TASKS triviaqa::olmes bbh:cot::olmes"
for TASK in $TASKS; do
  olmes --model-type vllm --model "$CKPT" --model-args "$MARGS" \
        --task "$TASK" --output-dir "$OUT/$(echo $TASK | tr ’:/’ ’__’)"
done For Llama-3.1-8B we set add_bos_token=true : olmes encodes prompts without special tokens, and a Llama model trained with a beginning-of-sequence token on every document produces degenerate output without it.

指挥. 一个检查站(Hugging Face模型目录)的环境和评价是: git 克隆 https://github.com/allenai/olmes.git QQ CD olmes

TASK 以 $TASKS 表示; 做
olmes - 型号 vllm - 型号 "$CKPT" - 型号参数 "$MARGS" \
任务“$TASK”——输出目录“$OUT/$(echo $TASK + r :/ ' + )”
对于Llama-3.1-8B,我们设置了添加_bos_token= true : olmes编码的提示没有特殊符号,一个Llama模型经过训练,在每个文档上有一个序列开始符号,没有它就会产生退化的输出.

blocks.en: Sharding. To finish each evaluation in minutes rather than hours, we split every task’s instances into 16 disjoint shards and run the command above on each shard in parallel, one GPU per shard. Per-subtask scores are combined across shards weighted by instance count, and the subject and subtask means are taken afterwards, which reproduces the aggregation of an unsharded run.
blocks.zh: 坚硬. 为了在几分钟而不是几个小时内完成每次评估,我们把每个任务的情况分成16个脱节的硬盘,并平行运行上面每个硬盘上的指令,每个硬盘一个GPU。 每分任务分数通过按例数加权的硬盘进行组合,主题和子任务手段在之后进行,它复制了未硬盘运行的集合.

blocks.en: C.3.1 Evaluation harness
blocks.zh: C.3.1 评价手段

blocks.en: Reasoning (“Think”) checkpoints are evaluated with the same software as Appendix C.2.2 ( olmes commit 5a51f502 , vLLM 0.13.0) but with the olmo3:adapt task specifications, the ones behind Ai2’s OLMo 3 Think model card. Every task is zero-shot and chat-formatted with the OLMo 3 Think chat template, whose generation prompt ends with <|im_start|>assistant\n<think> , so every response starts inside a reasoning block and the model must close it with </think> before its final answer. All generation is sampled with temperature 0.6 and top- p p 0.95. The model context is capped at 32,768 tokens (prompt plus response); AIME additionally caps the response at 16,384 tokens. Table 18 lists the six tasks.

blocks.en: Table 21 isolates the effect of teacher strength on Ambient SFT, holding the student fixed and varying only whether the frozen teacher is the small (124M) or large (1.5B) OWT-pretrained model. We report this comparison at both student scales considered in this work. At both scales, using the larger teacher matches or improves over the smaller one on every domain, indicating that our method continues to benefit from a stronger teacher even though, unlike classical KD, the teacher is never the stronger model at the target task – it is only used as a coarse, high-temperature regularizer (Section 3.2.2 ).

blocks.en: D.4 Baselines for instruction tuning
blocks.zh: D.4 指导调理的基准

blocks.en: We compare Ambient SFT with four baselines, each swept over a grid whose best value lies inside the grid: • L2-SP ( Li et al., 2018 ) penalizes the distance of the weights from the pre-trained weights. We sweep the penalty strength α ∈ { 0.001 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \alpha\in\{0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10\} . • NEFTune ( Jain et al., 2024 ) adds uniform noise to the input embeddings during fine-tuning. We sweep the noise scale α ∈ { 5 , 10 , 15 } \alpha\in\{5,10,15\} . • Knowledge distillation (KD) adds to vanilla SFT a KL term to the frozen base model at temperature T = 1 T=1 , i.e., our objective with T = 1 T=1 . We sweep the cross-entropy weight p c ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 0.9 } p_{c}\in\{0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9\} . • Label smoothing mixes the one-hot target with the uniform distribution with weight ϵ \epsilon . We sweep ϵ ∈ { 0.05 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } \epsilon\in\{0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4\} . The best settings are α = 10 \alpha=10 for NEFTune, α = 1 \alpha=1 for L2-SP, p c = 0.5 p_{c}=0.5 for KD and ϵ = 0.2 \epsilon=0.2 for label smoothing. Table 22 reports the full sweeps.

blocks.en: D.5 Per-source temperature
blocks.zh: D.5 均源温度

blocks.en: Dolci-Instruct-SFT is a mixture of 21 source datasets. For each source s s , we run the base model once over that source’s supervised tokens and measure the gap g s g_{s} between its cross-entropy on the observed tokens and its average predictive entropy. We then raise the temperature where the gap is large, so that the student relies less on the base model there. We use the rule T s = 2.5 ​ ( 1 + max ⁡ ( g s , 0 ) 0.1 ) , T_{s}=2.5\,\left(1+\frac{\max(g_{s},0)}{0.1}\right), which keeps T = 2.5 T=2.5 for sources the base model fits well. Sources such as math and code get temperatures between 2.5 2.5 and 3.4 3.4 , while poorly fit ones, such as CoCoNot and WildChat, get up to 10.7 10.7 . This rule is a simple heuristic rather than a tuned choice: we compared three such rules at Qwen3-1.7B, kept this one, and used its constants unchanged at 4B and 8B. Other rules based on the same gap may work better.
blocks.zh: Dolci-Instruct-SFT是21个源数据集的混合物. 对于每个源s,我们运行一个基础模型 超过源的受监督的符号, 并测量它的交叉 进入 与它的 平均预测 entrip。 然后我们提高空隙较大的温度,这样学生就不那么依赖那里的基模了. 我们使用规则 T s = 2.5 ( 1 + max + ⁡ (g s, 0 ) 0.1 ), T _{s 2.5\,\ left (1 +\frac\ max(g_{s}, 0) + 0. 1 + 右),使 T = 2.5 T = 2.5 的源头基本模型适合. 数学和代码等来源的温度在2.5-2.5-3.4-3.4之间,而CoCoConot和WildChat等条件差的则高达10.7 10.7。 这个规则是一个简单的heuristic而不是调制选择:我们在Quen3–1.7B比较了三个这样的规则,保留了这个规则,并且使用它的常数不变在4B和8B. 基于同样差距的其他规则可能更好。

blocks.en: Theorem 3.2 asserts a strict inequality, not the existence of a best ( λ , T ) (\lambda,T) , and the distinction is real. The risk depends on the pair only through M = λ ​ H T M=\lambda H_{T} , so λ \lambda sets the scale of the penalty and T T its shape, and the reachable shapes trace the curve T ↦ T 2 ​ H T T\mapsto T^{2}H_{T} , which starts at F F at T = 1 T=1 and tends to Σ 0 ⊗ G \Sigma_{0}\otimes G as T → ∞ T\to\infty . Convergence by itself decides nothing about attainment: if the target conditionals are uniform then T 2 ​ H T = Σ 0 ⊗ G T^{2}H_{T}=\Sigma_{0}\otimes G at every temperature and the curve is a single point. But the limiting shape need not be reachable at any finite T T , and then the joint infimum can fail to be attained even under the non-degeneracy condition. The following example does that, on an open set of teacher gaps. Keep the model of Remark E.7 but take b 1 2 = 2 / n b_{1}^{2}=2/n and b 2 2 = 1 / n b_{2}^{2}=1/n . By the Example below the best penalty eigenvalues are m j ∗ = 1 / ( n ​ b j 2 ) m_{j}^{*}=1/(nb_{j}^{2}) , that is ( 1 2 , 1 ) (\tfrac{1}{2},1) , whereas the reachable ratio is m 1 / m 2 = κ 1 ​ ( T ) / κ 2 ​ ( T ) = cosh 2 ⁡ ( 1 / T ) m_{1}/m_{2}=\kappa_{1}(T)/\kappa_{2}(T)=\cosh^{2}(1/T) , which exceeds 1 1 at every finite T T and tends to 1 1 only as T → ∞ T\to\infty . With λ \lambda free to set the scale, the reachable set is therefore exactly the open cone { m 1 > m 2 > 0 } \{m_{1}>m_{2}>0\} , and the unconstrained optimum ( 1 2 , 1 ) (\tfrac{1}{2},1) lies outside it. The optimum over the closure is a different point: each coordinate contributes ( m j 2 ​ b j 2 + μ j / n ) / ( μ j + m j ) 2 (m_{j}^{2}b_{j}^{2}+\mu_{j}/n)/(\mu_{j}+m_{j})^{2} , strictly decreasing then strictly increasing with minimum at m j ∗ m_{j}^{*} , so from any feasible m 1 > m 2 m_{1}>m_{2} one can move to the diagonal without increasing either contribution, and the constrained minimum sits on the face m 1 = m 2 m_{1}=m_{2} . That face is disjoint from the reachable set, so the infimum over finite ( λ , T ) (\lambda,T) is approached only as T → ∞ T\to\infty with λ ∝ T 2 \lambda\propto T^{2} and is never attained. Note that this is a different limit from the maximum-likelihood one in ( 10 ), which sends T → ∞ T\to\infty at fixed λ \lambda and does kill the penalty. Read positively, a missing minimizer says the model would like the hottest teacher available, with λ \lambda raised to compensate for the flattening.
